ḥst: ḥst — a word not known (noun; Budge's 'shutting in on every side' is a guess)
ḥwn: ḥwn — youth, child (noun m.; plural ḥwnw 'youths'; Budge: ḥunnu)
ḥwꜣ: ḥwꜣ — to rot, decay (verb; the noun ḥwꜣw is 'rottenness'; written with the classifier of swelling and decay; Budge: ḥua)
